lines.2: The Princess was the only one in the student council room.
lines.3: She drummed her fingers against the desk.
lines.5: Right. This was exactly when I needed the Princess Moodiness Memo Sato gave me.
lines.6: Drumming fingers on desk -> Danger Level 4 **** (WORST)
lines.8: Avoidance -> Escape without making eye contact.
lines.9: S-so as long as I didn't meet her eyes, I was safe.
lines.10: At the moment, the Princess was looking off in the other--
lines.14: She was staring at me with the eyes of a wild beast.
lines.15: You could also say she was trying to stare me down.
lines.16: 「Why are you skulking around, Tsushima? Why don't you come in?」
lines.18: Wait. Looking closer, was there a vein throbbing on her forehead?
lines.19: R-right. Sato's memo had instructions for this...
lines.23: 「Sorry, but would you make me some tea?」
lines.25: 「Yes. I will give you one minute.」
lines.26: Oof. What was with that subtly barbed reply?
lines.27: W-was there anything else in the memo?
lines.29: Note -> This state is exceedingly rare.
lines.30: Seeing it may make you lucky in a sense? (^o^)
lines.33: Damn. I had retorted without thinking.
lines.34: 「Tsushima, did you collect this week's suggestions from the boxes around school?」
lines.38: No. The atmosphere would not let me escape.
lines.39: 「What is this tea? It seems a little weak.」
lines.41: This side of her was why people had nicknamed her the Princess...
lines.44: There was no point making her angrier. Better humble myself.
lines.45: The weakness of a man in love, as they say.
lines.46: I did everything I could to avoid rubbing the Princess's temper the wrong way.
